verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS automation platform like Make, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API, a TypeScript SDK, an MCP server and Make Skills, but never an official command-line tool. The SDK and API are developer building blocks, and the MCP server belongs to a different story, so none of them count toward this one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
